text: Carried over from CR6a (2026-09-26): (1) a Diagnose instance for the host-facing FieldError returned by ParameterSet.validate, so Studio gets Diagnostics for method-field refusals; (2) ChoiceOption labels are currently the raw tokens, so give them display labels for S7.2; (3) the Scala.js java.math.BigDecimal(Double) bug (wrong for some negatives, e.g. -MaxValue): keep using the bit-exact number text, and never reintroduce that constructor.
